[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
local DEBUG = UE5_DEBUG or 0   -- 1 = show diagnostics + keep this window open
local function dbg(...) if DEBUG ~= 0 then print(...) end end
-- ================================================================
-- Property Freeze: DumperTestActor::TickCount
-- Generated by UE5CEDumper | https://github.com/bbfox0703/UE5CEDumper
--
-- REQUIREMENT: ue5_freeze_helper.lua MUST be embedded in this
-- table. Inject via UE5DumpUI:
--   Tools -> Inject Freeze Helper into Current CE Table
-- ================================================================

-- ====== EDIT VALUES BELOW =============================================
local CFG = {
  className          = 'DumperTestActor',
  derived            = true,  -- also hold every SUBCLASS (set false for exact class only)
  propOffset         = 0x6A8,
  valueType          = 'int32',
  value              = 9999,
  tickIntervalMs     = 50,    -- writes 20x/sec; lower = more CPU
  refreshIntervalSec = 5,     -- re-enum instances every 5s
  -- filter = function(addr) return true end,  -- optional
}
-- =====================================================================

-- Load ue5_freeze_helper.lua from the table file (no fs fallback).
local tf = findTableFile('ue5_freeze_helper.lua')
if not tf then
  showMessage(
    '[Freeze] ue5_freeze_helper.lua not found in this table.\n\n' ..
    'Setup: UE5DumpUI -> Tools -> Inject Freeze Helper into Current CE Table')
  if memrec then local _u=createTimer(nil,false) _u.Interval=50 _u.OnTimer=function(x) x.destroy() memrec.Active = false end _u.Enabled=true end  -- deferred: CE sets Active AFTER this block, so an immediate untick is a no-op
  return
end
do
  local ss = createStringStream()
  ss.copyFrom(tf.Stream, tf.Stream.Size)
  local fn, err = load(ss.DataString)
  ss.destroy()
  if not fn then
    showMessage('[Freeze] Helper load error:\n' .. tostring(err))
    if memrec then local _u=createTimer(nil,false) _u.Interval=50 _u.OnTimer=function(x) x.destroy() memrec.Active = false end _u.Enabled=true end  -- deferred: CE sets Active AFTER this block, so an immediate untick is a no-op
    return
  end
  fn()
end

-- Per-script keyed handle storage so multiple Freeze scripts
-- coexist in the same Lua engine without clobbering each other.
_ue5_freeze_handles = _ue5_freeze_handles or {}
local FREEZE_KEY = 'DumperTestActor::TickCount@0x6A8'

-- Defensive stop: if a previous activation didn't clean up
-- (rare -- AA Script reload while active), drop the stale handle.
if _ue5_freeze_handles[FREEZE_KEY] then
  pcall(_ue5_freeze_handles[FREEZE_KEY].stop)
  _ue5_freeze_handles[FREEZE_KEY] = nil
end

-- An abandoned freeze unticks this record instead of lying about it.
CFG.memrec = memrec

-- Build the freeze handle from CFG and start the timers.
local ok, handleOrErr = pcall(freezeProperty, CFG)
if not ok then
  showMessage('[Freeze] freezeProperty error:\n' .. tostring(handleOrErr))
  if memrec then local _u=createTimer(nil,false) _u.Interval=50 _u.OnTimer=function(x) x.destroy() memrec.Active = false end _u.Enabled=true end  -- deferred: CE sets Active AFTER this block, so an immediate untick is a no-op
  return
end
_ue5_freeze_handles[FREEZE_KEY] = handleOrErr
local sok, sok2, serr, scount, scapped = pcall(handleOrErr.start)
if not sok then
  _ue5_freeze_handles[FREEZE_KEY] = nil
  showMessage('[Freeze] start error:\n' .. tostring(sok2))
  if memrec then local _u=createTimer(nil,false) _u.Interval=50 _u.OnTimer=function(x) x.destroy() memrec.Active = false end _u.Enabled=true end  -- deferred: CE sets Active AFTER this block, so an immediate untick is a no-op
  return
end
if sok2 == nil then
  print('[Freeze] this table has an older ue5_freeze_helper.lua: it cannot report whether anything was frozen. Re-inject it via UE5DumpUI -> Tools -> Inject Freeze Helper into Current CE Table.')
elseif not sok2 then
  pcall(handleOrErr.stop)
  _ue5_freeze_handles[FREEZE_KEY] = nil
  showMessage('[Freeze] nothing was frozen:\n' .. tostring(serr))
  if memrec then local _u=createTimer(nil,false) _u.Interval=50 _u.OnTimer=function(x) x.destroy() memrec.Active = false end _u.Enabled=true end  -- deferred: CE sets Active AFTER this block, so an immediate untick is a no-op
  return
elseif scount == 0 then
  print('[Freeze] armed: no live instances of ' .. tostring(CFG.className) .. ' (or any subclass) right now -- the freeze applies as they spawn.')
elseif scapped then
  print('[Freeze] armed on ' .. tostring(scount) .. ' instance(s) of ' .. tostring(CFG.className) .. ' or a subclass -- CAP REACHED, so that is a floor, not a total: more instances exist and are NOT held. Narrow className in CFG to cover the ones you want.')
end

dbg(string.format('[Freeze] Started: %s::TickCount = %s (int32@0x6A8) on %s instance(s)', tostring(CFG.className), tostring(CFG.value), tostring(scount)))
if sok2 == true and scount ~= 0 and not scapped and DEBUG == 0 then synchronize(function() getLuaEngine().Close() end) end

{$asm}
[DISABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
local DEBUG = UE5_DEBUG or 0   -- 1 = show diagnostics + keep this window open
local function dbg(...) if DEBUG ~= 0 then print(...) end end
_ue5_freeze_handles = _ue5_freeze_handles or {}
local FREEZE_KEY = 'DumperTestActor::TickCount@0x6A8'
local h = _ue5_freeze_handles[FREEZE_KEY]
if h then
  pcall(h.stop)
  _ue5_freeze_handles[FREEZE_KEY] = nil
  dbg('[Freeze] Stopped: DumperTestActor::TickCount')
end
if DEBUG == 0 then synchronize(function() getLuaEngine().Close() end) end
{$asm}
